description: Agent Delegation: submit a system’s delegation records (each with its id, when the delegation was made, who delegated, who received it, what was delegated, the scope given, what came back, how it was settled: paid, accepted, sent back, disputed, cancelled or still open, and when the record was written) and optionally the delegations seen in other logs, such as payments, messages or a tracker. The signed report counts every delegation that keeps the essentials and names every record missing who delegated, who received it or what was delegated (the core a delegation cannot be audited without), every record missing the scope given, what came back or how it was settled, every record written more than a day after the delegation, and every delegation seen elsewhere with no record behind it, with the fix for each. This reads the record of delegations specifically: the record of handoff events is wever_handoff-record-check, the record of interruptions and recoveries is wever_recovery-record-check and the buyer’s record of paid calls is wever_purchase-record-check. Verdict delegations_unrecorded, record_gaps, records_unverified or delegations_recorded. POST /api/delegation-record-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-delegation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-delegation/.

returned.description: What came back, such as a reconciliation report with 3 open items.

scope.description: The scope given, such as invoices under 5,000 USDC with read-only ledger access until 30 November.

settled.description: How it was settled: paid, accepted with nothing owed, sent back, disputed, cancelled, or still open.

task.description: What was delegated, such as reconciling the October invoices.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

observed.description: Delegations seen in other logs, such as payments, messages or a tracker, to find delegations with no record.

name: wever_delegation-record-check
title: Delegation record check
